exercises: [IMF-181 | Dumbbell Shoulder Press, Seated] 4 sets of 10 reps, controlled press up and a slow lower back down
[IMF-188 | Dumbbell Lateral Raise] 4 sets of 12 reps, raise to shoulder height and resist the weight on the way down
[IMF-193 | Cable Front Raise] 3 sets of 12 reps, lift to shoulder height and control the descent
[IMF-172 | Face Pull] 3 sets of 15 reps, pull to forehead height and hold briefly at the end of each rep
[IMF-189 | Cable Lateral Raise] 3 sets of 12 reps each side, single arm, keep a slight bend in the elbow throughout
[IMF-199 | External Rotation, Cable] 3 sets of 15 reps each side, slow and controlled through the full range
